Bidder to indicate bid number and name of bidding entity in the transaction details field at the time of on- line transfer. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses RFP Compliance: All bidders/OEMs shall carefully read and understand the complete RFP, including the Sco pe of Work, Technical Specifications, SLA requirements, Payment Terms and all applicable terms and condi tions. The bidder shall submit the complete bid along with all required documentary evidence and declarations a s specified in the RFP/ATC. The bidder shall also submit the Land Border Undertaking, duly signed and sta mped by the Bidder and OEM, wherever applicable, in the prescribed format attached with the ATC. Contract Period: The contract shall be for an Initial Contract Period of Three (3) Years, including implement ation, OEM warranty/support and O&M services, as specified in the RFP. The Contract may be extended by GIL/DST for the further period, subject to the terms and conditions of the RFP and mutual agreement.

Submission of EMD and Other Documents: The bidder shall submit the Earnest Money Deposit (EMD), wher ever applicable, in the prescribed form, including DD/BG, as specified in the GeM Bid/RFP. The Non-Blacklis ting Declaration and other documents specifically required to be submitted in physical form shall be submi tted in a sealed envelope clearly mentioning the GeM Bid No., Name of the RFP and “PIM/PAM Solution”, ad dressed to the General Manager (Software Procurement), Gujarat Informatics Limited (GIL), within the stipu lated timeline specified in the Bid Schedule. OEM Authorization and Responsibility: The bidder shall submit valid OEM Authorization/MAF and other OEM -related documents as specified in the RFP. The successful bidder/OEM shall be responsible for providing the complete end-to-end PIM/PAM Solution, in cluding all required hardware, software, storage, licenses, implementation, integration, OEM support and o ther components/services specified in the RFP. Technical Demonstration / PoC: The bidder shall demonstrate the proposed PIM/PAM Solution through PoC/ Demonstration, wherever specified in the RFP, as per the prescribed technical requirements and evaluation criteria. The bidder shall arrange all necessary resources, software, licenses, appliances and tec hnical personnel required for the demonstration. . 7.
